title: Python - Regex Lookahead - GeeksforGeeks
snippet: Positive lookahead uses the syntax (?=pattern) and matches X only if followed by Y, without consuming Y. Negative lookahead (?!pattern) matches X only if NOT followed by Y. Both are zero-width assertions.

title: re - Regular expression operations - Python 3.14.6 documentation
snippet: Lookahead assertions do not consume characters in the string being matched; they only assert whether a match is possible at the current position.
